title: 第1章 小叔，我是阿瓷……
slug: 万一小叔对假千金是柏拉图呢
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

宋瓷是京圈出了名的乖乖女。

乖巧懂事，漂亮听话，用旁人的话来说，就是一朵人畜无害的菟丝花。

她最近在酝酿一个计划。

翡世国际，京市最顶奢的私人会所。

顶层私用电梯。

男人西装笔挺，神情淡漠。

密闭光洁的电梯内，映照出他的半张侧脸。

他身后的几个男人弯着腰，神情谄媚讨好，却各个噤若寒蝉，大气不敢喘。

“滴——”

电梯停在了一楼。

今天是男人回国第一天，飞机刚落地就来处理公事，脸色不算太好。

身旁的助手林鉴上前几步，拦住电梯门，毕恭毕敬。

“祝总，今天太晚了，还要去宋家拜访吗？”

男人回国第一件事，原本就是要去拜访宋家的，只不过因为公务耽误到现在。

低头看了眼手表，男人嗓音沉静：“明天再去。”

“好的祝总，我重新给您安排行程。”

说完，男人抬步往会所外走去。

一楼舞池，灯红酒绿，音乐声震透耳膜。

舞池的乐声喧嚣吵闹，有几个男生将一个女生围在了角落，灯光晦暗，时不时夹杂着几声调笑。

“抱歉，我不想喝酒，我的家人来接我了。”

宋瓷声音怯生生的。

她被几个身高体壮的男人堵在了角落，一身干净整洁的洁白衣裙，她低着头，眼眶微红，却在尽力保持镇定。

“妹妹，这个借口也太假了，就是跟哥几个喝杯酒嘛，别害羞……”

为首的黄毛勾唇上前，晃动着手中的酒杯，手上的动作也开始不安分起来。

浓密的长睫上挂了泪珠，宋瓷微微咬唇，向四周投去求救的视线。

周围分明也有人注意到了这里的动静，但看到几个人高马大的男人，还是移开了视线。

“妹妹别害怕，多少钱一杯？哥哥付得起……”

宋瓷只是摇头，目光掠过人群，在看到那人时，眼睛瞬间亮了起来！

“小、小叔！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Song Ci is a well-known good girl in Beijing circles.

She is well-behaved, sensible, beautiful and obedient. In the words of others, she is like a dodder flower that is harmless to humans and animals.

She is currently hatching a plan.

Feishi International, the most luxurious private club in Beijing.

Private elevator on the top floor.

The man wore a straight suit and looked indifferent.

In the sealed and smooth elevator, half of his profile was reflected.

Several men behind him were bent over, with flattering expressions on their faces, but they were all silent and did not dare to breathe.

"Dip——"

The elevator stopped at the first floor.

Today is the man's first day back home. He came to handle business as soon as the plane landed, and his face is not too good.

The assistant next to him, Lin Jian, took a few steps forward and blocked the elevator door, respectfully.

"Mr. Zhu, it's too late today. Do you still want to visit the Song family?"

The first thing the man did when he returned home was to visit the Song family, but he was delayed until now due to official business.

Looking down at his watch, the man said in a calm voice: "Go back tomorrow."

"Okay, Mr. Zhu, I will rearrange your itinerary."

After saying that, the man walked out of the club.

On the dance floor on the first floor, the lights were bright and the music was loud and loud.

The music on the dance floor was loud and noisy, and several boys surrounded a girl in a corner. The lights were dim and there were a few jokes from time to time.

"Sorry, I don't want to drink. My family is here to pick me up."

Song Ci's voice was timid.

She was blocked in a corner by several tall and strong men. She was wearing a clean and neat white dress. She lowered her head, her eyes were red, but she was trying her best to stay calm.

"Sister, this excuse is too fake. I'm just having a drink with my brothers. Don't be shy..."

The leader, Huang Mao, stepped forward with his lips raised, shaking the wine glass in his hand, and the movements of his hand began to become restless.

There were tears on her thick long eyelashes. Song Ci bit her lip slightly and looked around for help.

There were obviously people around who noticed the movement here, but when they saw a few tall men, they still looked away.

"Don't be afraid, sister, how much does a cup cost? Brother can afford it..."

Song Ci just shook his head and glanced across the crowd. When he saw that person, his eyes lit up instantly!

"Little, uncle!"
